svg.title: H07 / KEPLER CO ECHO engineering mission profile
svg.desc: H07, KEPLER CO ECHO. Original project: Increasing CO Gas Detections in Protoplanetary Disks. Session H: Planetary Science. Scientific question: How much additional line-detection completeness does Keplerian alignment provide at a controlled false-discovery rate, and which disk populations remain poorly constrained? Testable hypothesis: Velocity-aligned stacking with independently constrained geometry will recover weaker lines than fixed-aperture integration, whereas unrestricted tuning on noise will produce unreliable significance.. svg.text: Increasing CO Gas Detections in Protoplanetary Disks
No project observations acquired · specified cases await execution · shared demonstrations are separately labeled
Reanalyze faint ALMA carbon-monoxide isotopologue emission by aligning
spectra with disk rotation before stacking. Preserve the original
CASA/GoFish archival-recovery concept while adding rigorous controls for
parameter searching, correlated noise, and nondetections. The Chamaeleon I
survey supplies a published comparison population. More detected CO lines
can improve chemical and kinematic constraints; they do not automatically
How much additional line-detection completeness does Keplerian alignment
provide at a controlled false-discovery rate, and which disk populations
TESTABLE HYPOTHESIS / NOT AN OBSERVED RESULT
Velocity-aligned stacking with independently constrained geometry will
recover weaker lines than fixed-aperture integration, whereas unrestricted
tuning on noise will produce unreliable significance.
A thin Keplerian disk is the initial alignment model; emitting height,
pressure support, warps, and cloud absorption may shift velocities.
Stellar mass, position angle, inclination, and systemic velocity are
constrained independently where possible, with uncertainty propagated.
VALIDITY LIMITS / THE CLAIM STOPS HERE
CO freeze-out, photodissociation, chemical depletion, optical depth, and
isotope-selective effects break a simple CO-flux-to-gas-mass conversion.
Stacking can hide spatial contamination; an apparent aligned line still
COUNTS OF RECORDS · NO COMPLETION SCORES
TRACEABILITY / IDs THAT STAY WITH THE WORK
Execution evidence is required before case closure.
Long et al. (2017), ALMA CO isotopologue survey
References are pointers; archive acquisition is separate.
